mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting to an easing policy, lowering discount rates and encouraging equity investment, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS declining > 3 months, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a risk-off reaction in equity markets, compressing discount rates and reducing future cash flow valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of tightening episodes, or walk-forward Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.
